title: Princess Baby Clipart
author: AMBillustrations
description:
Baby girl clipart set, my little princess! This birthday girl baby set is great with her ballet slippers, crown, tutu, flower, necklace and her onesies. You can make your own clipart princess and be part of the creative process. An ideal set for all your craft projects for your little princess. This set includes onesies, or onezies, hair bands, crowns, quotes for the onezie and elements to decorate your onezie. Create your own little princess with the elements which are all supplied individually. This vector clipart set is suitable for invitation making , embroidery digitizing, ribbons, fabric, scrapbook and all your crafting.
You will receive the follow graphic elements
– Each clipart saved separately in 6” x 6” 300 dpi PNG files, transparent background.- Each clipart saved separately in 6” x 6” 300 dpi JPEG files, white background.
– 1 EPS file.
Princess Baby Clipart AMB-1293
